contentRating.rationale: Recommend these ratings because Riot contains user-generated content and community reporting; authenticated store questionnaires still require human confirmation.

termsAcceptance.reason: No in-app Terms or user-policy acceptance flow was found.

prohibitedContent.reason: No published prohibited-content rules tied to the app were found.

filtering.reason: No objectionable-content filtering control was found.

contentReporting.reason: No in-app content-reporting flow was found.

authorReporting.reason: No in-app author-reporting flow was found.

localBlocking.reason: No immediate local author-blocking control was found.

moderatorTombstone.reason: Protocol tombstones exist, but no report-to-moderator response workflow was found.

publicContact.reason: Public support page (marketing/support/index.html) names the responsible operator and public contact channel.

reportAcknowledgement.reason: Public support page commits to acknowledging every report on the public email channel within 24 hours.

imminentHarm.reason: Public support page commits to a 24-hour decision for imminent-harm or illegal-content reports on the public channel.

objectionableContent.reason: Public support page commits to a 72-hour decision for other objectionable-content reports on the public channel.
